marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Looks at the importance of proper nutrition and sleep in the first year and how infants rely on their innate reflexes and how gross and fine motor skills emerge in typically developing children as well as those with challenging conditions. Explores infant intelligence, information processing and memory, including the progression of infant communication. Examines the different stages of emotional development and how children form attachments with people. Shows how personality and temperament affect an infant's social and emotional growth and how caregivers handle various situations.
